title: Mystery of explosive diarrhea parasite outbreak in the US
desc: Currently, 145 people from 20 states have contracted a cyclospora parasite, with 20 hospitalized and no deaths. Experts are not sure what's caused the outbreak of cyclosporiasis.

title: Melissa Gilbert Mourns Daveigh Chase’s Death
desc: Melissa Gilbert mourned ‘Lilo & Stitch’ star Daveigh Chase’s death and cautioned the parents of child actors: ‘I would also ask that these parents memorize this sweet girl’s face and her story so that it never happens again.”

title: Rain, windstorms likely in upper parts from Wednesday evening as heat, humidity persist
desc: The Pakistan Meteorological Department (PMD) on Tuesday forecast very hot and humid weather in the country's plain areas on Wednesday with chances of   rain-windstorms and thunderstorms in upper Punjab, upper Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan and northeastern Balochistan during the evening or night.
